import { supabase } from './supabase'
import type { GearItem } from '@/types/database'
import type { Repository } from './persistence'

class GearRepository implements Repository<GearItem> {
  private readonly userId: string

  constructor(userId: string) {
    this.userId = userId
  }

  async create(item: Omit<GearItem, 'id' | 'user_id' | 'created_at' | 'updated_at'>): Promise<GearItem> {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .insert({ ...item, user_id: this.userId })
      .select()
      .single()

    if (error) throw error
    return data
  }

  async read(id: string): Promise<GearItem | null> {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .select('*')
      .eq('id', id)
      .eq('user_id', this.userId)
      .single()

    if (error && error.code !== 'PGRST116') throw error
    return data
  }

  async update(id: string, updates: Partial<Omit<GearItem, 'id' | 'user_id' | 'created_at' | 'updated_at'>>): Promise<GearItem> {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .update(updates)
      .eq('id', id)
      .eq('user_id', this.userId)
      .select()
      .single()

    if (error) throw error
    return data
  }

  async delete(id: string): Promise<void> {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .delete()
      .eq('id', id)
      .eq('user_id', this.userId)

    if (error) throw error
  }

  async list(): Promise<GearItem[]> {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .select('*')
      .eq('user_id', this.userId)
      .order('category')
      .order('name')

    if (error) throw error
    return data || []
  }

  async createMany(items: Omit<GearItem, 'id' | 'user_id' | 'created_at' | 'updated_at'>[]): Promise<GearItem[]> {
    const itemsWithUserId = items.map(item => ({ ...item, user_id: this.userId }))
    
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .insert(itemsWithUserId)
      .select()

    if (error) throw error
    return data || []
  }

  async count(): Promise<number> {
    const { count, error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('user_id', this.userId)

    if (error) throw error
    return count || 0
  }
}

export const createGearRepository = (userId: string) => new GearRepository(userId)

import { supabase } from './supabase'
import type { GearItem } from '@/types/database'
import type { Repository } from './persistence'

class GearRepository implements Repository<GearItem> {
  private readonly userId: string

  constructor(userId: string) {
    this.userId = userId
  }

  async create(item: Omit<GearItem, 'id' | 'user_id' | 'created_at' | 'updated_at'>): Promise<GearItem> {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .insert({ ...item, user_id: this.userId })
      .select()
      .single()

    if (error) throw error
    return data
  }

  async read(id: string): Promise<GearItem | null> {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .select('*')
      .eq('id', id)
      .eq('user_id', this.userId)
      .single()

    if (error && error.code !== 'PGRST116') throw error
    return data
  }

  async update(id: string, updates: Partial<Omit<GearItem, 'id' | 'user_id' | 'created_at' | 'updated_at'>>): Promise<GearItem> {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .update(updates)
      .eq('id', id)
      .eq('user_id', this.userId)
      .select()
      .single()

    if (error) throw error
    return data
  }

  async delete(id: string): Promise<void> {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .delete()
      .eq('id', id)
      .eq('user_id', this.userId)

    if (error) throw error
  }

  async list(): Promise<GearItem[]> {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .select('*')
      .eq('user_id', this.userId)
      .order('category')
      .order('name')

    if (error) throw error
    return data || []
  }

  async createMany(items: Omit<GearItem, 'id' | 'user_id' | 'created_at' | 'updated_at'>[]): Promise<GearItem[]> {
    const itemsWithUserId = items.map(item => ({ ...item, user_id: this.userId }))
    
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .insert(itemsWithUserId)
      .select()

    if (error) throw error
    return data || []
  }

  async count(): Promise<number> {
    const { count, error } = await supabase
      .from('gear_items')
      .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('user_id', this.userId)

    if (error) throw error
    return count || 0
  }
}

export const createGearRepository = (userId: string) => new GearRepository(userId)

- Updated `count()` to return `{ count: number; categories: number }`
- Uses two efficient queries: one for gear count, one for unique categories

- Added `isLoadingCounts`, `categoryCount` states
- Changed `gearCount` from `0` to `null` initially 
- Added skeleton loading states for both cards
- Updated onboarding condition to prevent showing during loading
- Fixed gear count increments to handle `null` state

### 🎯 Benefits:
- ✅ **No more flickering** on dashboard load
- ✅ **Real category count** displayed
- ✅ **Better UX** with skeleton loading states  
- ✅ **Type-safe** extension of count functionality
- ✅ **Efficient** - single API call for both counts
